mfa-enforcement-defaults.reason: Owner decision in chat on 2026-10-10: MFA stays a Security Center switch. Enabled in the admin panel means enforced, not enabled means not enforced. desk.wabo.ai is staging and keeps it off there; production turns it on from the admin panel. Re-verify the production value before each release.

operator-mfa-ignored.reason: Same owner decision: the operator switch (requireMfaForSuperAdmins) decides whether operators are challenged; when it is off an enrolled operator is not asked. Kept deliberately (commit 5f741143) so staging can run without a second factor. Production must have the switch on.

password-composition.reason: Owner asked for strong password defaults that stay configurable in the admin panel. The default is now 12+ characters, blocklist and breach check on; the upper-case/number rules stay on by default (Reference parity) and can be switched off in the Security Center.
